name: codeglyph-vscode
description: Subtle AI-chosen watermark icons behind functions, classes and properties, in any programming language.

commands.title: CodeGlyph: Change icon of symbol at cursor...
CodeGlyph: Hide icon of symbol at cursor
CodeGlyph: Use automatic icon for symbol at cursor

codeglyph.provider.description: Auto uses an API key when one exists, then the Claude Code CLI. The model gets symbol names and comments. It never gets code bodies.

codeglyph.claudeCliPath.description: Path of the claude command. It can only be set in user settings.

enumDescriptions: Strict: only close matches. Fewest icons.
Balanced: recommended. Icons that a developer would accept.
Generous: more icons, with looser matches.
codeglyph.iconSensitivity.markdownDescription: How sure the model must be before an icon is shown. A change shows at once, with no new model calls.

codeglyph.minConfidence.markdownDescription: Advanced. An exact confidence limit from 0 to 1. It replaces `#codeglyph.iconSensitivity#`. Leave it empty to use the sensitivity. Strict is 0.7, Balanced 0.5, Generous 0.4.

codeglyph.editDelaySeconds.description: Provider calls for new or changed symbols wait this long after your last edit. Cached icons are not delayed.

codeglyph.useLocalWords.description: Pick the icon with no model call when the name has known words like Email, Invoice or Order. Turn it off to let the model decide every name.

codeglyph.logUsage.description: Write tokens and cost for each provider call to the CodeGlyph output channel.

codeglyph.excludedLanguages.description: Language IDs that never get icons.

codeglyph.minSymbolLines.description: Symbols shorter than this get no icon.

enumDescriptions: One color for types, methods and properties.
Each icon name gets its own stable color, so equal concepts have equal colors in all files.

codeglyph.kindColors.description: Colors used when colorMode is bySymbolKind.

codeglyph.strokeWidth.description: Line width in pixels. It stays the same at every icon size.

codeglyph.placement.markdownDescription: `fixedColumn` puts the icon at `#codeglyph.column#`, behind long lines. `afterCode` puts it right of the longest line of the symbol.

codeglyph.column.description: Text column where the icon starts. Lower it if your editor is narrow.

codeglyph.overlapCode.description: Allow the icon behind code. If off, no icon is shown where it would touch code.

codeglyph.minLines.description: Smallest icon height in lines. If the free lines are fewer, no icon is shown.

codeglyph.fadeInMs.description: An icon fades in softly when it first appears. 0 turns the fade off.

codeglyph.hover.description: Show where the icon came from when you hover the first line of a symbol. The hover has links to change or hide the icon.

codeglyph.verbBadges.description: Show a small badge for the first word of a method name: Create, Delete, Get, Send, Validate, Update, Sync.
